acceptance_profile.sane_row: isfinite(N0) && N0 > 0 && all(isfinite, F) && 1e-3 < sigma_own/sigma_bote < 1e3; a row failing twice is not written (fail-closed)

boundary: This file lists the inputs that causally determine the table values. How they are implemented is fixed by generator_commit and generator_source_fingerprint in each table file, not by this hash.

e0_grid_rule.merge: sorted union; drop a node within 2 % (ratio <= 1.02) of the previous kept node, unless it is an absolute node, which then replaces the previous

eps_quadrature.segments: 1: eps in [0, E_th], eps = E_th*x^2, Gauss-Legendre n1 on x in (0,1) / 2: eps in [E_th, (D+E_th)/2], log-uniform, n2 / 3: upper end, D - eps = scale*y^2, n3; D = E0 - E_th. Low overvoltage (D <= 2 E_th): segments 1 and 3 only

limits: Nuclear charge is modelled as a uniformly charged sphere; the difference against a two-parameter Fermi distribution at fixed <r^2> is not covered by this specification.
Tc (Z=43), Pm (Z=61) and At (Z=85) have no published charge radius and fall back to R = 1.2*A^(1/3) fm; the permitted set is fixed (formula_gap_z) and any other element falling back is an error.
Po (Z=84) and Rn (Z=86) have no natural abundances; the reference isotopes Po-209 and Rn-222 are used.
S (99.231 %), V (99.750 %) and Ta (99.988 %) do not reach 100 % abundance coverage because the radius of a minor isotope is unmeasured (for Ta this is the 180m isomer).
The experimental charge radii carry their own uncertainties, which are not propagated.

Isotopes of an element are collapsed into one nucleus preserving the abundance-weighted <r^2>; measured at Sm K 200 keV this shifts N0 by 5.0e-09 relative, against 2.3e-05 for the finite-vs-point effect itself.
Consequently sub-eV binding energies and ppm-level sigma_own are outside what this dataset claims.

lkin.containment: r_eff = r_b[i], i = first index with cumsum(rho .* gradient_(r_b)) >= radius_frac * total; rho = G^2 + F^2 on the Dirac path, u_b^2 otherwise
lkin.l_max: min(l_cap, max(6, min(l_kin, l_barrier))); l_kin = ceil(kappa * r_eff) + margin; l_barrier = floor(sqrt(2 r_c + 2 eps r_c^2)), r_c = r_core + 2

nucleus.note: The per-element resolved radii, source classes, abundance coverage and isotope lists are not repeated here; provenance_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the full block, which every shipped table carries verbatim under "nucleus" and which check_tables C17 recomputes.

s_cert.rule: largest S_GRID point <= min(S_GRID[end], margin / lambda_e(E0)) (+1e-12 tolerance); F is exactly 0 beyond it

tail.eps_rule: eps = max(EPS_FLOOR, EPS_SAFETY * sup|F| on [s_cert - EPS_WINDOW, s_cert])
